title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
original_title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
plot_overview: In a bold 28-day experiment, a comedian tours the UK and US while following a fried chicken diet. The journey explores the appeal of the craving and the industry behind it, looking at both the personal experiment and the wider food business.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you’re curious about fast food, cravings, and the industry behind them; Not for you if you prefer fictional stories or a broader range of subjects.
review_summary: Pros: bold experiment; food industry focus; cross-country journey | Cons: narrow subject; diet-centered premise
